execution.client: Trusted authorized Linux CPU client host
execution.clientOperations: Embeddings, nonlinearities, attention, private KV state, quantization, decoding, decryption and full encrypted replay
execution.evaluatorOperations: All 169 admitted model linear operations on ciphertexts and public evaluation material; no decryption key

resourceControls.diskEnforcement: Monitored dedicated-root stop, not filesystem quota

limitations: The client host operator is trusted with plaintext and the secret key; this is not browser-local key custody.
Full encrypted replay provides no client compute saving or independently reviewed malicious security.
Native changes, parameter selection, interaction leakage and selective failures are not independently qualified.
SSH pins an endpoint/account; it does not attest applications, hardware or accelerators.
Protocol byte counters exclude SSH/TCP overhead and one-time dependency, source and model provisioning.
One public four-token fixture is neither corpus quality evidence nor a full Flash run.
Low-priority shared-host measurements are not an isolated comparison against ordinary Doppler or another FHE system.
Later repository scheduling, prepared-cache and source-owner changes are not deployed in this experiment.
observationClass: Operator-observed authorized research execution, not independent attestation
